items.source: NOTE that the body contents must be completely consumed, relayed, or released to avoid memory leaks.
items.translation: 注意，必须完全消耗、转发或释放主体内容，以避免内存泄漏。

items.source: Return the name of the event, as provided through the Content-Disposition name parameter.
items.translation: 返回通过`Content-Disposition name`参数提供的事件名称。

items.source: Return the content of this event. The returned buffer must be consumed or released.
items.translation: 返回此事件的内容。返回的缓冲区必须被消费或释放。

items.source: Return the headers of the part that this event belongs to.
items.translation: 返回该事件所属部分的标题。

items.source:
Indicates whether this is the last event of a particular
part.
items.translation: 指示这是否为特定部分的最后一个事件。

items.source: File uploads will produce one or more FilePartEvents, containing the filename used when uploading. If the file is large enough to be split across multiple buffers, the first FilePartEvent will be followed by subsequent events.
items.translation: 文件上传将产生一个或多个FilePartEvent，其中包含上传时使用的文件名。如果文件足够大以至于需要跨多个缓冲区拆分，第一个FilePartEvent之后将跟随后续事件。

items.source: Form fields will produce a single FormPartEvent, containing the value of the field.
items.translation: 表单字段将产生一个单个FormPartEvent，包含该字段的value。

items.source: Form fields can be created via FormPartEvent.create(String, String).
items.translation: 可以通过FormPartEvent.create(String, String)创建表单字段。

items.source: File uploads can be created via FilePartEvent.create(String, Path).
items.translation: 可以通过FilePartEvent.create(String, Path)创建文件上传。

items.source: Return the content of this event.
the name of the part, never null or empty
items.translation: 部件的名称，永远不为`null`或空。
